description: Source code for the 'cpuacct' cgroup subsystem implementation, including functions to retrieve CPU usage statistics and manage cgroup settings.

classes.name: CpuacctGroup
classes.description: Represents the 'cpuacct' cgroup subsystem with methods to apply settings, retrieve stats, and set configurations.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the cgroup subsystem, 'cpuacct'.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Applies the cgroup configuration to a specified path and process ID.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets configuration parameters for the cgroup (no-op in this implementation).

methods.name: GetStats
methods.description: Retrieves CPU usage statistics for the specified cgroup path.
